description: A New Dynamic Stochastic EV Model for Power System Planning Applications is a model or code deposit deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Mohamed Mokhtar, Mostafa Shaaban (American University of Sharjah). The uploaded data file is a part of data used or generated by a model proposed in a paper entitled: “A New Dynamic Stochastic EV Model for Power System Planning Applications”. The proposed model in this paper consists of two sub-models which are the travel behavior and the battery depletion sub-models. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
